what: Map-side data for Escape from Tarkov: hand-placed corrections and additions, BattlePass document locations, and the story campaign.
pairsWith: api/quests.json, joined by quest id and by map name.

mergeContract.rule: Compare dates per section, not per file. Keep whichever value is newer.
mergeContract.firstParty: Everything marked `placed by hand` was positioned in a map editor by a player against the game itself. No published source carries any of it, so there is usually nothing to merge it against.
mergeContract.coordinates: Game units, in tarkov.dev's coordinate space, so a position here can be compared with an objective zone in quests.json directly. `floor` is -1 on a map with no floors.

placed.what: Positions placed by hand in the tracker's map editor, checked against the game.
placed.datingNote: The day the data was last baked.

overlay.what: tarkov-data-overlay (tarkovtracker-org), the source of the story chapter list.
overlay.note: Chapters only. Their locations, and every hazard and interactable, are hand-placed.

keyFormats.hidden: kind|map|name|... where kind is "ex", "label" or similar
keyFormats.note: A label may itself contain "|". Split from the RIGHT by the number of trailing fields the format has, never from the left.
